subject: Mental Models
title: Divergent and Convergent Thinking
description: One-minute skill: Divergent and Convergent Thinking.

hook.text: A brainstorming session produced 60 wild ideas. Then the team picked three and refined them. Two phases, one solution.

buildup.text: Divergent thinking generates many options without judgment.

discovery.text: Problems arise when teams mix the two. Judging ideas during brainstorming kills creativity.

climax.text: Separate the phases explicitly. First diverge without limits: no bad ideas.

punchline.text: Create first, judge later. Never at the same time.

quiz.question: Why should divergent and convergent thinking be separated?
options: They use different parts of the brain
Judging ideas during brainstorming kills creativity and mixing wastes time
Only one phase is ever needed
